```{python}
import htmltools
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import sys
import os
import datetime

project_root = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.getcwd(), '..'))

if project_root not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, project_root)

import src.chartkit as ck
from src.metrics_calculator import MetricsCalculator
from src.database import DatabaseManager

ck.apply_style()

calculator_30d = MetricsCalculator(db_path="../data/analytics.db", days=30)
calculator_60d = MetricsCalculator(db_path="../data/analytics.db", days=60)
calculator_90d = MetricsCalculator(db_path="../data/analytics.db", days=90)
calculator_all = MetricsCalculator(db_path="../data/analytics.db", days=None)

db = DatabaseManager("../data/analytics.db")
```

```{python}
def visualise_backlog_trend(calculator: MetricsCalculator) -> None:
    fig, ax = ck.question_figure("Is the open backlog growing?")
    df = calculator.get_backlog_trend()
    if df.empty:
        ck.empty_state(ax, "No backlog data for this period yet.")
        plt.tight_layout()
        plt.show()
        return
    df = df.copy()
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    df = df.set_index('date')
    days = calculator.days
    # Thin the series so markers don't turn into soup: daily for short windows,
    # weekly at 90 days, monthly across the full multi-year history.
    if days is not None and days <= 60:
        resampled = df
    elif days == 90:
        resampled = df.resample('W-MON').agg({'backlog': 'last'}).dropna()
    else:
        resampled = df.resample('MS').agg({'backlog': 'last'}).dropna()
    resampled = resampled.reset_index()
    ck.timeseries(ax, resampled, x='date',
                  series=[{'col': 'backlog', 'label': 'Open backlog'}],
                  ylabel='Open items (PRs + issues)', integer_y=True)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
```

```{python}
def visualise_code_churn(calculator: MetricsCalculator) -> None:
    fig, ax = ck.question_figure("How much code is changing?")
    df = calculator.get_code_churn()
    if df.empty:
        ck.empty_state(ax, "No code-churn data for this period yet.")
        plt.tight_layout()
        plt.show()
        return
    df = df.copy()
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    df = df.set_index('date')
    days = calculator.days
    if days is not None and days <= 60:
        resampled = df
    else:
        resampled = df.resample('MS').agg({'additions': 'sum', 'deletions': 'sum'}).dropna()
    resampled = resampled.reset_index()
    ck.timeseries(ax, resampled, x='date',
                  series=[{'col': 'additions', 'label': 'Lines added'},
                          {'col': 'deletions', 'label': 'Lines removed'}],
                  ylabel='Lines of code', integer_y=True)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
```

```{python}
def visualise_release_timeline(calculator: MetricsCalculator) -> None:
    fig, ax = ck.question_figure("How much lands in each release?")
    df = calculator.get_release_and_pr_timeline()
    if df.empty:
        ck.empty_state(ax, "No releases in this period yet.")
        plt.tight_layout()
        plt.show()
        return
    df = df.copy()
    df['release_date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['release_date'])
    df = df.sort_values('release_date')
    ck.bars(ax, df, x='release_date',
            series=[{'col': 'merged_pr_count', 'label': 'Merged PRs'}],
            ylabel='Merged PRs in release')
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
```

```{python}
def visualise_new_contributors_per_quarter(calculator: MetricsCalculator) -> None:
    fig, ax = ck.question_figure("Are new people still joining?")
    df = calculator.get_cumulative_contributors(freq='QE')
    if df.empty:
        ck.empty_state(ax, "No contributor data for this period yet.")
        plt.tight_layout()
        plt.show()
        return
    df = df.copy()
    df['period'] = pd.to_datetime(df['period'])
    ck.bars(ax, df, x='period',
            series=[{'col': 'new_contributors', 'label': 'New contributors'}],
            ylabel='New contributors')
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
```

```{python}
def visualise_cumulative_contributors(calculator: MetricsCalculator) -> None:
    fig, ax = ck.question_figure("How has the contributor base grown?")
    df = calculator.get_cumulative_contributors(freq='QE')
    if df.empty:
        ck.empty_state(ax, "No contributor data for this period yet.")
        plt.tight_layout()
        plt.show()
        return
    df = df.copy()
    df['period'] = pd.to_datetime(df['period'])
    ck.timeseries(ax, df, x='period',
                  series=[{'col': 'cumulative_contributors', 'label': 'Cumulative contributors'}],
                  ylabel='Cumulative contributors', integer_y=True)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
```
